description: This file defines a Java interface 'Response' in the package 'com.romraider.logger.ecu.comms.query'. It declares methods related to handling logger data, such as setting data values, retrieving data sets, and timestamps.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: An interface representing a response with methods to manipulate and retrieve logger data and timestamps.

methods.name: setDataValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific LoggerData item.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns a set of LoggerData objects associated with the response.

methods.name: getDataValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific LoggerData.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the response.
